lines.text: Tracky follows every peso: what came in, where it went, and what was left.
Every transaction lands in one place, sorted by day and by category.
Budgets keep each category in check, before the month runs away.
Savings goals show how far you've come, and how far there is to go.
And the AI advisor turns your own activity into plain answers.
Tracky. A little more in control. Built by Keith Vergara.
